title: Detailed windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x='0' y='82' width='100' height='18' fill='#2e7d3a'/>

  <polygon points='42,82 58,82 54,44 46,44' fill='#e8d9b0'/>
  <polygon points='42,82 46,82 46,44 46,44' fill='#cdbb8a'/>
  <polygon points='58,82 54,82 54,44 54,44' fill='#b9a877'/>

  <polygon points='44,44 56,44 50,28' fill='#c0453a'/>
  <polygon points='44,44 50,44 50,28' fill='#a5362d'/>
